findings.message: Initial review found symlinked effort roots could bypass status-migration apply path safety; repair rejects symlinked effort roots, index, workflow, events, and target parent paths before mutation.

Independent review found sync failures after successful file/index renames could leave partial state while returning blocked; repair marks replacements rollback-owned immediately after rename and adds a sync-failure rollback regression.
Independent review found --json flag-parse failures returned plain stderr; repair emits typed blocked status-migration plans for JSON parse errors and adds unknown-flag/malformed-revision coverage.
Follow-up review found --json=true still fell back to plain flag output on parse errors; repair recognizes boolean JSON flag spellings before parse-error output selection.

residual_risk: Low. Apply uses temp writes, guarded rename sequencing, rollback after post-rename failures, symlink rejection under the effort tree, and best-effort fsync calls. Crash consistency still depends on filesystem rename/fsync semantics.
